restart_seed_rule: first seed equals top-level seed; later seed = 1 + ((top_seed * 1000003 + restart_index * 104729) mod 2147483646), restart_index starts at 1
deadline_rule: monotonic deadline starts before worker process launch; graph parse, conversion, executable launch, validation, and controller overhead all count; only fully validated outputs checkpointed before the deadline are creditable
endpoint_rule: minimum independently recomputed backward-arc weight among complete feasible orderings checkpointed before deadline; timeout without such an ordering has no objective
ipsns_incumbent_rule: frozen function writes complete order only on return; progress scalar is not a valid incumbent; no instrumentation or inferred trajectory
analysis_rule: descriptive per-input status, objective, normalized objective difference, restart improvement and wall/CPU diagnostics; no significance test or population-level claim
